description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - A Certificate of Exemptions were issued to Tokyo Cement Company Lanka (PLC)
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity generation, which constitutes a regulatory action and falls under legal/statutory instruments rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
